description: Effect of intercropping (growing two or more crops simultaneously in the same field) on crop yield compared to sole cropping / monoculture

pico.population: Field crops (cereals, legumes, vegetables) grown in intercropping systems
pico.intervention: Intercropping (strip, row, relay, mixed) with any companion crop
pico.comparison: Sole cropping / monoculture of the same crop
pico.outcome: Crop yield (grain yield, biomass, total yield) of the primary crop or combined system

search_query: intercropping AND (yield OR productivity OR biomass) AND (monoculture OR sole OR monocrop)

benchmark.source: Yu et al. 2015, Agronomy for Sustainable Development
benchmark.effect_description: Intercropping increases total yield by ~22% (Land Equivalent Ratio 1.22)
benchmark.notes: Meta-analysis of 100 studies; LER = 1.22 means 22% more total land needed for monocultures to match intercrop output. Also supported by Li et al. 2020 (10.1016/j.fcr.2019.107585) finding similar magnitudes.

replaces: cover_crop_soybean (dropped due to <1% OA PDF availability)
